# The Comprehensive List of AI Agent Frameworks and Orchestration Tools

> a curated, source-linked directory of open-source and commercial frameworks for building, orchestrating, deploying, and operating AI agents. Includes a machine-readable catalog. CC0 licensed. Reviewed monthly; last reviewed 2026-07-16.

Every entry links to a primary source. Availability markers distinguish open source, open weights, open core, commercial products, and public standards/resources. There is no paid placement. Confident AI, DeepEval, and DeepTeam are separate entities maintained by the same team and follow the same evidence rules.

## Main content

- [Full list](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aglio-lab/ai-agent-frameworks/main/README.md): 175 source-linked entries across 15 catalog sections
- [JSON catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aglio-lab/ai-agent-frameworks/main/data/tools.json): structured entity records
- [CSV catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aglio-lab/ai-agent-frameworks/main/data/tools.csv): flat machine-readable index
- [Monthly maintenance policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aglio-lab/ai-agent-frameworks/main/MAINTENANCE.md): review schedule and evidence rules

- Browser, Computer-Use, and Coding Agents (18 entries)
- Tool Use, MCP, and Integration Infrastructure (18 entries)
- Agent Memory and State Infrastructure (9 entries)
- Low-Code and Visual Agent Builders (13 entries)
- Durable Execution and Background Workflows (10 entries)
- Cloud-Managed Agent Services (12 entries)
- Agent Deployment, Serving, and Sandboxes (12 entries)
- Agent Evaluation, Observability, and Testing (15 entries)
- RAG and Knowledge-Agent Frameworks (8 entries)
